summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests intismeran autogene (V940) with pembrolizumab and chemotherapy, compared with placebo, as first-line treatment for metastatic squamous non-small cell lung cancer. Intismeran autogene is given as an injection into the muscle on Days 1 and 22 of cycles, up to 2 doses in induction and up to 7 doses in maintenance, while pembrolizumab is given by IV infusion every 6 weeks for up to 15 doses in maintenance. The study measures whether participants live longer overall and go longer without the cancer growing or spreading, compared with participants who receive placebo.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa intismeran autogene (V940) con pembrolizumab y quimioterapia, comparado con placebo, como tratamiento de primera línea para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas de tipo escamoso metastásico. Intismeran autogene se administra como inyección en el músculo los días 1 y 22 de los ciclos, hasta 2 dosis en la fase de inducción y hasta 7 dosis en la fase de mantenimiento, mientras que pembrolizumab se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 6 semanas, hasta 15 dosis durante el mantenimiento. El estudio mide si los participantes viven más tiempo en general y pasan más tiempo sin que el cáncer crezca o se propague, en comparación con los participantes que reciben placebo.
who_for: Has squamous non-small cell lung cancer that is stage IV (metastatic).
Has measurable disease based on RECIST 1.1 criteria.
Has a tissue sample from a site not previously treated with radiation.
Has an ECOG performance status of 0 to 1.
Has a life expectancy of at least 3 months and is 18 years or older.
not_for: Has received a prior cancer vaccine, including another personalized cancer vaccine.
Has received prior systemic anticancer therapy for metastatic lung cancer.
Has received prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-PD-L2 therapy, with limited exceptions for early-stage treatment.
Has active central nervous system metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Has active autoimmune disease that needed systemic treatment in the past 2 years.
